verdict.rationale: Navan documents its own policy and approval workflows ("Unlimited policy and approval workflows"), policy limits applied at booking, and flag/decline reasons with designated approvers. That covers the approval-enforcement part of the story only thinly, and nothing shows budgets allocated to teams or projects or card spend limits tied to them. missing for 10: budget allocation to teams/projects, configurable card spend limits enforcing budgets, evidence that approvals block over-budget spend, independent or hands-on corroboration.
